ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Lost"), OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(Loss_Reason_CC__c)), AND( ISPICKVAL(Loss_Reason_CC__c, "Other"), ISBLANK(Closed_Lost_Comments_CC__c) ) ), NOT($CustomMetadata.Trigger_Framework_Config_CC__mdt.Opportunity.Bypass_Validation_CC__c), $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Loss Reason is required. If Loss Reason is Other, please provide Closed Lost Comments.
